name: com.triband.storey
description: Procedural buildings with walk-in interiors: data model, bake-time geometry generation, semantic LODs, occlusion and streaming hooks. Runtime package; authoring tools are in com.triband.storey.authoring.

samples.description: The prototype's demo buildings imported from JSON, plus the play kit scene.
Storey's materials lit like the Flamingo/Color Palette/ColorPallete-Lit shader graph; a template for lighting Storey with a project's own model.
